title: Siege of Toulon (1707)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Toulon (1707)", at revision 1382486452, opens: "The siege of Toulon took place between 29 July and 21 August 1707 during the War of the Spanish Succession, when a combined Savoyard-Imperial army supported by a Anglo-Dutch naval force, attacked the French base at Toulon." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q708610, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1707 siege of the War of the Spanish Succession". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
